posts.text: Claude's AI watermark can't identify you. Detecting it requires one secret key Anthropic holds, shared across every user, every account, every session. It flags "Claude-consistent or not," nothing more. Pinning it to a person needs a separate legal-process step against account records, per Anthropic's own policy: it discloses user info only "in accordance with valid legal process." If you're worried about AI content tracing back to your business, the watermark itself isn't the risk.
